Name: Simba
Description: Simba - Adult Male Cat Looking for Experienced, Pet-Free Home  This is a very difficult post for me to make. I am currently pregnant and due very soon, and with my partner being in the military, I need to find Simba a new home before the baby arrives.  Simba came to me from a friend who told me he had his shots, but I do not have any paperwork or vet records for him, and I have not taken him to the vet since having him.  Simba is a very strong-personality cat and will need an experienced cat owner who understands cats with behavioral challenges. He must be the only pet in the home. He does not do well with other animals and can show aggression if he feels stressed, threatened, or overstimulated.  Simba has bitten through the skin in the past when he was overstimulated or frightened, so he needs an experienced owner who understands cat body language and can manage those situations calmly.  At the same time, Simba can be very sweet. He is talkative, enjoys attention on his terms, and does like to cuddle when he feels safe and comfortable. In the right environment, his affectionate side really comes out.  In a calm, quiet environment with someone patient and knowledgeable, Simba has the potential to do much better. He needs a home with: �'ۢ No other pets �'ۢ No small children �'ۢ Someone experienced with cats and willing to work with his behavior �'ۢ A calm, stable environment  This is not a situation where I am trying to 'get rid' of him. I care about him and want him placed with the right person who understands what they are taking on and is willing to give him the time and space he needs.  I am hoping to find him a home by the end of February / early March due to my pregnancy timeline.  A small rehoming fee will apply to ensure serious inquiries only.  If you feel you are a good fit, please reach out and tell me about your experience with cats and your home environment.  Thank you for reading.

He's a big boy . He has no behavioral or health problems. The best home for him would be to live as a single cat. He could live with a cat friendly dog. A quiet home would be ideal. Name: Panda
Description: Panda is a social buddy who loves to cuddle. His favorite thing to do is follow you around and ask for pets. In return he'll make you some biscuits. He's a big boy so he's not the most active but will play fetch. Catch him napping most of the time though! He is bonded with Luna who also needs a home. Please adopt both together!

Name: BIG BOO
Description: Big Boo is a fun, friendly 2�%BD-year-old black-and-white cat who genuinely loves people. He's the kind of guy who leans right in for pets, sticks close to you, and clearly enjoys being part of whatever's going on.  He has a playful side and enjoys toys and games, and he does well with other cats. That said, he'd also be totally happy as your one-and-only as long as he gets plenty of attention. If you're looking for a social, affectionate cat with a great personality, Big Boo is definitely worth meeting! ��%90%BE

Name: DESI
Description: This beautiful 7-year-old girl came to us after leaving an unsafe and abusive home, (literally abandoned in a contentions divorce), so she's understandably shy and cautious. She'll need a patient, gentle hand to help her feel safe and loved in her new surroundings.  She can be a little wary of men and new experiences at first, but once she trusts you, her sweet, affectionate personality truly shines. With people she bonds with, she loves to snuggle-sometimes even curling up under the covers for a cozy nap.  Right now, she hasn't been comfortable around other cats or dogs, so a quiet, calm home would be best. She's searching for a loving family willing to let her build confidence at her own pace. In return, she will offer unwavering affection and a truly special bond that's worth every moment of patience and care.

Description: She is a 10 month old long haired calico Minx is a young adventurous cat who loves to cuddle and play. She is very intelligent and listens when called. I need to rehome her because she isn't doing well with some of the other cats. She leaves them alone but occasionally bothers them. The best home would be one where she is the only cat. She is very affectionate and deserves attention and love.

Name: Sadie
Description: Sadie is a sweet, gentle girl with a cozy personality and a love for quiet companionship. At 10 years old, she's past the kitten chaos and enjoys peaceful routines, warm naps, and sharing space with her people. She's affectionate once settled and can be a real cuddle bug, especially when she gets to lay on your chest or perch on your shoulders while you're relaxing.  Sadie loves window watching, lounging up high in a cat condo, and claiming the coziest spots in the house.  She's in good health and spends much of her day napping, watching the world go by, and soaking up attention on her own terms! Sadie is litter-box trained (prefers it very clean), loves a scratcher, does well with kids and other pets, and will likely hide under the bed during loud moments like vacuuming.  If you're looking for a calm, comforting companion who forms meaningful bonds and enjoys quiet togetherness, Sadie could be a wonderful addition to your home.

She enjoys laying near her human at night on back of couch and getting gentle pets on her chipmunk cheeks. A sweet gal.she enjoys looking out window at birds and squirrels.

Name: Sadie
Description: Sadie is a 10-year-old long-haired cat (born July 2015) with a gentle, thoughtful personality. She's independent, low-maintenance, and happiest in a peaceful, low-key environment.  She enjoys doing her own thing and doesn't need constant attention, making her a wonderful companion for someone who values calm energy and quiet presence. She's affectionate on her own terms and can be such a sweetie once she feels comfortable-those moments of affection feel extra special because she chooses them.  She loves warm, cozy spaces like sunny windows, blankets, and heated throws, and will happily spend her days relaxing nearby. She can be shy around new people and loud environments, but thrives with patience, routine, and respect for her space.  She would do best in a calm home with someone who appreciates an independent cat with a soft, loving side and understands that trust takes time. In the right home, she'll be a peaceful, comforting presence and a truly special companion.

Name: Spud
Description: Meet your new bud, Spud! �ٴ����� Spud earned his name because, until recently, he lived outside in the dirt - just like a little potato! This adorable void quickly became a neighborhood favorite thanks to his friendly personality and gentle nature. Spud has FIV, which just means he'll do best as an only cat or with other calm, FIV-positive cats. FIV cats can live long, healthy lives indoors with good care and regular vet visits. He also has a mild heart murmur that's being checked out, but he currently shows no symptoms and feels great. Now that he's safe inside, Spud has shown what a sweetheart he truly is. He loves pets and attention, treats and scritches, and enjoys hanging out near his people. He's adapted beautifully to indoor life and is ready to find a calm, loving forever home. Spud approximately 2 years old. If you're looking for a sweet, loyal companion who's been through a lot and still has nothing but love to give, Spud might be your perfect match!   More of Spud:  https://photos.app.goo.gl/8j95bGcExHtz8GWt5

I believe he likes to be the main cat he doesn't do well with unknown scents; he takes baths very calmly just cut his nails first! he's litter trained and sheds a lot! I am moving away and can't take him with me I want him to be in a loving home. He has a calm personality; he really will let you know if he needs something! Simon is an indoor cat; he is good with other animals. He just needs someone who will be patient with him. Simon is litter trained. When it comes to people and other animals, he can be very shy and anxious before he gets comfortable.

Name: Cheddar
Description: Cheddar is going to 16 years old this year and is such a sweet, loving boy. He just wants a person to cuddle with in his twilight years. He is talkative and silly, exactly what you would expect from an orange cat. He loves scratches on his cheeks, space heaters, camera bags, and screaming for wet food. He is a fairly tolerant cat when it comes to being messed with. He likes when you chant his name. He has been around children and crowds (holiday parties) and done well with both. He is a very  Cheddar was adopted by my mom and 1 from a family friend when he was ten weeks old in July 2010. My mom passed away in 2024 and a friend agreed to take Cheddar in. I wanted to keep him, but I already knew he didn't get along with my cat as she is very territorial. Recently, my friend reached out to let us know that while Cheddar was great with two of their cats, he did not get along with their third cat and they had started fighting. She asked for our help in finding him a better home.

Name: Noni
Description: I'm looking for a loving placement for my 10-year-old cat, Noni. She's sweet, gentle, and enjoys being outdoors.  A few years ago she was hit by a car and, as a result, is incontinent. She needs to be expressed daily and may leave stool around. Despite this, she's otherwise healthy, mobile, and very sweet. She especially loves being outdoors and relaxing in the sun.  I've recently accepted a job that requires me to move to San Francisco, and unfortunately I won't be able to bring her with me due to her special needs and my upcoming living situation. This has been an incredibly hard decision, and my priority is making sure she ends up somewhere safe and kind.  I believe she would do best in a quiet rural setting, farm, or sanctuary, ideally with someone experienced with special-needs animals or comfortable providing gentle daily care.  I'm happy to share vet records, photos, and help with transportation or initial costs if needed.  If you or someone you know is able to help, I would be deeply grateful. Name: ABIGAIL
Description: ADOPT A SENIOR LADY!  Abigail's journey has been a challenging one. Initially, her previous owner brought her to the vet to be euthanized :( But one of our local vets, saw the spark in her and reached out to us for help.  In her last home, Abigail had some difficulty interacting with her owner, so the owner thought euthanasia was the answer. Weird. Click below and see her arriving at our shelter:  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9cEEDiw9UKA  In her previous environment, there were both a dog and another cat, and Abigail felt a bit out of sorts around them. We think she should be the only animal in a loving home!  Come down to the cat lounge and meet her. She was saved for a reason!

Name: PAN
Description: Pan (The Man) is an amazing 4-year-old neutered male Domestic Shorthair who has overcome so much. This sweet angel endured a terrible act of cruelty, abandoned on the roadside in the desert heat, confined in a small fabric carrier with only some M&M's for company. Understandably, he was quite reactive and scared due to his past trauma when he first came to us.  Fast forward three weeks, and Pan is now thriving, officially embracing his title as THE MAN. We adore this laid-back kitty! He loves to find the highest perches in our space, where he can snooze peacefully . Whenever we come to visit, he eagerly hops down, turns into a little chatterbox, and can't get enough of those head rubs!  Fast forward 2 months and PAN is in a foster home! Here is what his foster mom said last check in!  'I'm amazed by how loving and sweet Pan is even though he experienced severe trauma by the hands of humans. He's been friendly to anyone new who has come by the house and he even met my friends bigger dog and approached without fear, only friendly interest :) he loves to play, get pets and love, and really loves food and treats. He's a great kitty all around!'  Email :

Description: Sabrina is a 5-year-old, 8.5-pound bundle of pure love. The moment you meet her, she starts purring and doesn't stop. She adores being close to her humans, rubbing against you for pets and curling up nearby just to be near you. She's the kind of cat who makes biscuits on her soft bed while gazing up at you with the sweetest eyes. Sabrina is playful and gentle, and she enjoys the company of other cats once she's had time to get to know them. She's more affectionate than most cats, truly a little cuddlebug who just wants to love and be loved. Whoever adopts Sabrina will gain a constant companion with the softest heart.

He enjoys being held for short snuggles, but his adventurous side soon takes over-he loves to run free, climb, and explore every agility course he can get his paws on.  If you're looking for a playful, affectionate companion who blends cuddles with endless entertainment, Hawk is ready to soar into your heart!

Description: Meet Charles Darwin!  You won't believe this, but sweet Charles has never had a home! This boy has spent his life at Save the Meow Meows! We brought him to us to get a fresh start!  With a calm and easygoing personality, Charles Darwin is like a keen observer, much like his namesake!  He's happiest in relaxed, cozy settings and gets along well with friendly feline buddies. Name: Kyle
Description: Meet Kyle - The gentlest little soul looking for his forever home. Kyle came to us as a stray about two years ago and he's been nothing but love ever since. He is an easy, sweet nature cat who does beautifully with adults and children. He's a little shy with men at first but he warms up quickly once he knows he's safe.  Kyle is happiest as an indoor/outdoor cat. He'll curl up inside with you, then politely wait by the door when he needs to go out. He uses a litter box if needed but he also has great outside manners and prefers having access to fresh air and a bit of roaming.  The only reason we're looking for a new home for him is because our older very dominant cat has never accepted him, and we're worried it may lead to a fight. Kyle deserves a peaceful home where he can relax, explore, and be part of the family. He's gentle, affectionate, and easy to care for. He just needs a loving home where he can be himself.  If you're looking for a sweet companion who will adore you quietly and faithfully, Kyle might be your guy.  I will travel outside of our area if needed to deliver him for the right home.

Name: CC
Description: CC was rescued from a large cat colony when she was about four months old. She's a beautiful and rare solid orange tabby girl (most orange tabbies are male) which makes her all the more special. Petite and sweet-natured, CC loves to be petted and is especially fond of belly rubs. Though she was shy and skittish at first, she has grown into a gentle and affectionate young lady with her foster mom. However, she's still shy with new people and places, so she would do best with someone who's patient and understanding as she adjusts to her new surroundings and people. Ideally, her adopter will have experience with cats, especially those who are on the shy side. CC gets along with other cats, though she may take a little time to warm up to them. With some love, time, and care, she'll become blossom into a wonderful and devoted companion for someone. CC CC craves attention from her human. She is vaccinated, dewormed, treated for fleas, and microchipped. She's ready for her forever, loving home.

Name: Stacy
Description: Stacy was rescued from a very large colony when she was about four months old.  She was shy/skittish at first but has blossomed into a very sweet girl.  Stacy still is shy with new people and places, but once comfortable, she is loving and affectionate. She loves to be pet and roles over for tummy rubs.  She also will head butt you when she wants to be pet.  Since she is still shy with new people, she would do best with someone that is experienced with cats, especially shy ones, and will need some patience and understanding while adjusting to a new home and people.  She has one of the sweetest dispositions though and worth the initial effort.  Stacy is a striking tabico with soft white fur and delicate calico tabby markings, accented by distinctive black eyeliner around her eyes. She's gentle, mellow, and not at all dominant. Stacy gets along well with other cats and enjoys playing with her toys. One of her sweetest habits is gently sniffing noses before settling in close for pets. She's a lovely, tender soul looking for someone to help her shine. Stacy is vaccinated, dewormed, treated for fleas, and microchipped.  She'll be a great addition to someone's home.

Name: Tattoo
Description: Tattoo was rescued from a large cat colony with his sister when he was about four months old. He was scared and skittish at the time, but since working with him he's warmed up and become a sweet boy. He is still shy with new people and places though and would therefore do best with someone that is experienced with cats, especially shy ones.  Once comfortable though, Tattoo loves to be pet and play with the other foster kitties. He's a very handsome brown tabby with a soft looking face.  He'll take some understanding and patience while adjusting to a new home and people, but once comfortable he's a very good boy and would a great friend for someone. Tattoo is vaccinated, defleaed, dewormed, and microchipped.  He would love to be adopted with his sister or one of his other foster siblings, but he can also be adopted by himself to a loving home.

Name: Taboo
Description: Taboo was rescued from a large cat colony when she was about four months old. Although she was initially skittish and scared, she has blossomed into a sweet girl who enjoys being pet and even loves belly rubs. She gets along well with other cats and has fun playing with her foster siblings. Taboo is intelligent and gentle-natured, though not the dominant type. She can still be shy, especially in new environments or around unfamiliar people, so she would do best with someone experienced with cats, especially shy ones; she'll need someone with patience and understanding while she adjust to her new home and people. Once she feels comfortable though, her affectionate personality shines through. With time and care, she'll become a loving and loyal companion. Taboo is vaccinated, dewormed, treated for fleas, and microchipped.  She would love to be adopted with her brother Tattoo or another foster kitty from that came from the same place, but can also be adopted to a good home by herself.  Taboo will be a great friend for someone.

Name: Ginger
Description: Ginger was rescued along with her littermates from the river trail when she was a kitten. She was born a feral kitten and has since been socialized, but she is still shy/skittish with new people and places.  Ginger would do best with someone that is experienced with cats, especially shy ones. It takes time for her to trust new people and places, so she will need someone that is patient and understanding while she adjusts. Once she's comfortable though, she loves to be pet and is very playful.  Ginger might do best with a mellow male cat as a friend or as an only cat since she can be a bit alpha. She is vaccinated, dewormed, defleaed, and microchipped. Ginger will make a great friend for someone once settled in, and be a fun addition to one's home.

Name: Hypatia
Description: Hypatia was rescued from a homeless encampment when she was a teenager and very pregnant.  Unfortunately, she ended up losing her babies and was then spayed.  I believe she was born in the encampment and was sleeping in a tent with a homeless woman, so she is shy and skittish and will take some time and work to warm up. Hypatia would do best with someone that is experienced with cat, especially shy/skittish ones.  With some time and effort, though, she'll be a good companion for someone who is patient and understanding with her while she adjusts.    Hypatia is a beautiful dilute tortoiseshell Maine Coon mix.  Her fur is fluffy in the winter, especially her tail, and she has the shorter legs of a Maine Coon.  Hypatia loves other cats and playing with her toys.  She is a sweet cat that can be a great friend for someone. Hypatia is spayed, vaccinated, dewormed, defleaed, and microchipped.  She's ready for her forever home.

Name: Mimosa
Description: Mimosa was rescued with her son Bradley when she was about 1 1/2 years old. They were from a feral/stray colony and skittish when rescued, but Mimosa and her son have become sweet kitties that love to be pet and play. Mimosa is still shy with new people, so she would do best with someone that is experienced with cats, especially shy ones, and patient and understanding while she adjusts to a new home and people. Once comfortable though, she'll be a great friend for someone. Mimosa is a beautiful dark tortoiseshell girl with a sweet disposition. She loves to be pet and play with her toy and gets along well with other cats. Mimosa would love to be adopted with her son Bradley, but can also be adopted by herself to a loving home. Mimosa is vaccinated, dewormed, defleaed, and microchipped. She will be a great friend for someone

Name: Bindi
Description: Bindi is a sweet girl with a beautiful gray marble tabby and white coat. She was rescued with her sisters from under a freeway overpass. Bindi is shy around new people at first, so she would do best with someone who is experienced with cats, especially shy ones. Once she's comfortable and settled in though she's a real love bug. She likes to play with toys and be pet, but prefers not to be picked up. She is laid back and would do well in a quiet home with no children, and someone who will give her a lot of love. She would also do best as an only cat since she tends to just tolerate other cats. She might do ok with a mellow male cat though.  Bindi loves the catio her foster mom built! This allows her to enjoy the outdoors safely, while inside a large, enclosed area. Bindi is spayed, vaccinated, dewormed, defleaed, and microchipped. She'll make a great companion for someone.

Name: Ava
Description: Ava was rescued when she was about three months old. She was born on the streets from a stray mom. Right away I noticed something different about Ava. She had a strange looking tail. It was short, curled, and crooked. But she still wags it and her tail is very animated like a normal length tail. It looks like Ava was born with her tail like this. Since being rescued Ava has been in foster care. She was skittish and took a while to socialize, but is a spunky, playful girl now who loves to run around and play with toys. Ava is still shy with new people but loves to be pet and sits on her foster mom's laptop when the latter is working. Ava would do best with someone that is experienced with cat, especially shy ones, and one who is patient while she adjusts to her new home and people.  She's a funny girl with a lot of personality. Ava is spayed, dewormed, vaccinated, defleaed, and microchipped. She'll make a great friend for someone.

Name: GONZO
Description: Meet Gonzo!  Approx 1 year old, male neutered, Domestic Shorthair.  This handsome dude spent his entire life thus far at the Save the Meow Meows lounge. While he loves his Meow Meow family and they are equally obsessed with with, he's been consistently overlooked so he's joined the JT fam to get some fresh eyes!  This gentle boy is about to have a birthday; will he join your family just in time to celebrate?  He's a shy guy in our digs but he's a sweetie who just wants to be loved. He does well with various cat personalities but he prefers they be nice to him; swatting and hissing scares him into his hidey-holes.  Will work for Churu and catnip!

Name: BRAD KITT
Description: Meet Brad Kitt!  Approx 4 month old, male neutered, Domestic Medium hair.  Have you seen a jet black tabby?? You have now!  Not a common color pattern, this handsome gentleman (hence his namesake) is a black cat with stripes. Brad is a little on the shy side but that's just because he needs more socialization. He has done impeccably well with our other kittens and really likes to snuggle up to them. He doesn't like fast movements but he DOES love the magical kitty elixir that is Churu. He's one of those 'bites the package' to get more guys!

Name: Malina
Description: Malina is a gentle, mellow young tortoiseshell with striking butterscotch and black 'catwalk camouflage' and the sweetest, soulful dark round eyes. She enjoys the company of other cats, but cherishes quiet time curled up on a cat tree. Naturally shy and cautious, Malina warms up with patience and enjoys gentle petting. She'll often follow you, reaching out for more attention. She's happiest being near you rather than on your lap, and shows affection with soft purrs, quiet morning greetings, and gentle love blinks.

Name: Calypso
Description: Calypso is a talkative, friendly, spirited calico with bursts of playfulness followed by deep, cozy naps. She stretches and chirps to greet you, loves attention, and likes to follow you around, exploring and checking in on what you're doing. She's social and playful but sensitive, and may give a quick nip if overstimulated, so her people need to read her cues. Calypso has a big personality and could do well alone or with another easygoing cat. With her gold eyes, dramatic eyeliner, and clever, independent nature, she's entertaining and striking. With gentle guidance and a consistent routine, Calypso will bring colorful energy to your home.

Name: Fozzy Bear
Description: Fozzy Bear is a sweet, playful young muppet who alternates between zooming after toys and lounging in a sunny window. He enjoys the company of other friendly cats and even helps shy ones come out of their shell. Fozzy is a big boy and likes to be petted, but he's also quite shy and can be jumpy, always ready to dart away if unsure. A reassuring voice and gentle hand will help him relax. With patience, he will warm up and show his sweet side, offering soft kisses, graceful poses, and elegant tail swirls.
